import sys,json,hashlib,copy
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import yaml
repo=Path.cwd();skill=repo/".agents/skills/monitor-tune-isaaclab-training/scripts";sys.path.insert(0,str(skill))
from summarize_training_log import StreamingLogSummary
from algorithm_profiles import load_registry,resolve_profile
root=repo/"learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0/2026-10-03_22-59-50"
pre=json.loads((root/"evidence/source/assessment-preflight-20261004-001.json").read_text())
log=repo/"wandb/run-20261003_230002-cedxjaw0/files/output.log"
size=log.stat().st_size;limit=2*1024*1024;offset=max(0,size-limit)
with log.open("rb") as f:f.seek(offset);payload=f.read(limit)
if offset:payload=payload[payload.index(b"\n")+1:]
profile=resolve_profile(load_registry(),"rsl-rl-roa")
parsers={w:StreamingLogSummary(log,w,profile) for w in (20,100,300)}
for line in payload.decode("utf-8",errors="replace").splitlines():
 for p in parsers.values():p.feed_line(line)
for p in parsers.values():p.finish()
summaries={str(k):p.snapshot() for k,p in parsers.items()}
assert all(s["window_size"]==int(w) for w,s in summaries.items())
assert summaries["300"]["last_iteration"]==49997
records=summaries["300"]["records"]
assert all(b["iteration"]==a["iteration"]+1 for a,b in zip(records,records[1:]))
previous=copy.deepcopy(parsers[100]);previous.rows.clear();previous.rows.extend(records[-200:-100])
comparison={k:{"previous_100":v,"latest_100":summaries["100"]["mean"].get(k)} for k,v in previous.snapshot()["mean"].items()}
runlog=repo/"logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa"
a=yaml.load((runlog/"2026-10-02_14-30-02/params/env.yaml").read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
b=yaml.load((runlog/"2026-10-03_22-59-50/params/env.yaml").read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
diff=[]
def walk(x,y,p=""):
 if isinstance(x,dict) and isinstance(y,dict):
  for k in sorted(set(x)|set(y)):walk(x.get(k),y.get(k),p+"."+k if p else k)
 elif x!=y:diff.append({"path":p,"old":x,"new":y})
walk(a,b)
assert [x["path"] for x in diff]==["log_dir","rewards.feet_distance_y_exp.params.std","rewards.penalize_hip_roll_action"]
out=root/"evidence/training/final-training-log-summary-20261004-001.json";out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
value={"version":1,"created_at":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"analysis_kind":"bounded_final_training_log_summary",
"run_identity":pre["run_identity"],"effective_config":pre["effective_config"],"checkpoint":pre["checkpoint"],
"log":{"path":str(log),"file_size_bytes":size,"tail_start_offset":offset,"tail_max_bytes":limit,"parsed_tail_sha256":hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),
"parsed_tail_lines":parsers[300].lines_seen,"last_console_iteration":49997,
"console_tail_limitation":"WandB stdout ends before final checkpoint; final checkpoint next-iteration counter50000 verified separately"},
"summaries":summaries,"adjacent_100_iteration_means":comparison,"configuration_diff_vs_45000_run":diff,
"velocity_observation_noise":b["observations"]["policy"]["joint_vel"]["noise"],
"interpretation":{"finite_tail_metrics":all(not s["non_finite_metrics"] for s in summaries.values()),
"iteration_order_monotonic":True,"training_reached_checkpoint_counter":50000,
"not_a_live_health_assessment":True,"sufficiency":"insufficient_evidence","convergence":"indeterminate",
"reason":"No approved acceptance criteria; reward and iteration completion cannot establish convergence"},
"analysis_source":{"python":_controller_source,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(_controller_source.encode()).hexdigest()},
"direct_parameter_change_supported":False}
with out.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False);f.write("\n")
wanted=lambda m:{k:v for k,v in m.items() if any(s in k for s in ("reward","episode_length","termination","vel","hist","surrogate","std"))}
print(json.dumps({"path":str(out),"windows":{w:{"first_iteration":s["first_iteration"],"last_iteration":s["last_iteration"],"mean":wanted(s["mean"])} for w,s in summaries.items()},"adjacent_100":wanted(comparison),"config_diff":diff},ensure_ascii=False))
